subject.title: fix(doctor): migrate legacy google provider config to current catalog schema (#102138)

question: Should the legacy Google provider repair land in this core runtime-model migration, or should it be moved to the Google plugin doctor contract before merge?
rationale: Repository policy and the existing doctor-contract registry point provider-owned config repairs to plugin contracts, but this PR and the sibling PRs are overlapping live candidates for the same P0 upgrade bug.

options.title: Use the Google plugin doctor contract
options.body: Move or consolidate the repair into the Google plugin doctor contract, then land one branch with full legacy-shape coverage and proof.

options.title: Keep the core migration with explicit signoff
options.body: Maintainers can decide this historical config shape is core-owned, but the mixed-api defect still needs fixing before merge.

options.title: Pause until one sibling is repaired
options.body: Keep this PR open while selecting a sibling branch as the canonical fix, then close or supersede the others after a safe replacement is ready.

recommendation.title: Use the Google plugin doctor contract
recommendation.body: Move or consolidate the repair into the Google plugin doctor contract, then land one branch with full legacy-shape coverage and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal is recent Google provider ownership and plugin-boundary work.
